steps: Browse r/forhire filtered by the [Hiring] flair for posts matching your skills.
Read each post's requirements, budget, and contact instructions (many posts list rates, e.g. '$18 per hour').
Reply to the post or DM the poster with your portfolio, rate, and availability.
Negotiate and agree on scope, pay, and payment method in writing before starting any work.
catches: Pay is set by each poster and is often low; nothing is standardized or guaranteed.
No escrow or payment protection — agree on payment terms upfront; non-payment risk is yours.
Scam risk is real (advance-fee, fake-check, and phishing schemes); never pay to get a job and never cash checks for strangers.
Competition is intense: hundreds of thousands of members chase the same [Hiring] posts.
Posters are anonymous; check account age and history before engaging.
biggest_catch: There is no payment protection and no guaranteed work: every dollar depends on a deal you negotiate yourself with an anonymous poster, and scams are common.
eligibility: Free Reddit account (13+ per Reddit's terms); open worldwide.
timing: New [Hiring] posts appear continuously, daily; you reply on your own schedule.
